Ex: Putting the bookcase together should be a simple assembly job.

install

(verb). Lắp đặt

Ex: Make sure the equipment is properly installed.

launch

(noun). sự phóng

Ex: The launch of the space shuttle was delayed for 24 hours because of bad weather.

prior

(adjective). trước đó

Ex: Although not essential, some prior knowledge of statistics is desirable.

sneeze

(verb). Hắt hơi

Ex: Someone sneezed loudly at the back of the hall.

vacuum

(noun). chân không, khoảng không

Ex: Other gases rush in to fill the vacuum.

bacterium

(noun). vi khuẩn

Ex: The bacterium Streptococcus pneumoniae causes about a third of some 3,000 annual meningitis cases.

archaeologist

(noun). nhà khảo cổ học

Ex: A team of archaeologists are working on a previously undisturbed area of the abbey grounds.

astronaut

(noun). phi hành gia

Ex: How much food do we need to have on the spacecraft for the astronauts to go to Mars?

remove

(verb). loại bỏ

Ex: Remove the pan from the heat and continue to stir the sauce.

analysis

(noun). phân tích

Ex: Further analysis revealed significant regional variations in the results.

artefact

(noun). đồ tạo tác

Ex: The limestone and marble foyer was lined with artifacts

astonish

(verb). Làm ngạc nhiên

Ex: The news astonished everyone.

fragment

(noun). mảnh

Ex: Police found fragments of glass near the scene.

reveal

(verb). Tiết lộ

Ex: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

apparent

(adjective). Rõ ràng

Ex: It soon became apparent to everyone that he couldn't sing.

discover

(verb). Khám phá

Ex: She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

reject

(verb). Từ chối, bác bỏ

Ex: The bank has the option of accepting or rejecting this offer.

research

(noun). nghiên cứu

Ex: His researches in the field of disease prevention produced unexpected results.

theory

(noun). Giả thuyết; học thuyết

Ex: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

administrative

(adjective). thuộc hành chính, thuộc quản trị

Ex: The new study looks at the amount of time police officers spend on administrative tasks.

contamination

(noun). sự làm ô nhiễm

Ex: Environmental contamination resulting from human activities is a major health concern.

encase

(verb). Bọc

Ex: His upper body was completely encased in bandages.

explain

(verb). giải thích

Ex: He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.

innovative

(adjective). mang tính sáng tạo

Ex: There will be a prize for the most innovative design.

object

(noun). vật, vật thể

Ex: The scanner detected a metal object.

preserve

(verb). Bảo quản, giữ gìn

Ex: Efforts to preserve the peace have failed.

purpose

(noun). mục đích

Ex: Our campaign's main purpose is to raise money.

set up

(verb). thiết lập

Ex: The slump on Wall Street set up a chain reaction in stock markets around the world.

survive

(verb). Sống sót, tồn tại

Ex: They spent two months in the jungle, surviving on small animals and fruit.
